278650394.description: This lot includes 12 vintage glass telephone pole insulators primarily manufactured by Hemingray and Whitall Tatum. The insulators are made of clear, aqua, and light green glass and feature embossed branding and model numbers, including Hemingray-42 and Whitall Tatum No. 1. The condition varies among pieces, with some showing visible chips, cracks, and signs of wear consistent with age and use. These insulators are historically significant for telegraph and power line applications and are commonly collected or used as decorative items. Overall, the set is used with minor to moderate damage on certain pieces. Approximately 3.75" D, 4" H each.
